name: sessions
description: Native software development infrastructure for AI systems, AI agents, and humans.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared packages/codevault-core packages/native-repository packages/commercial-core packages/timeline-engine packages/verification-engine && pnpm --filter @sessions/sdk build && pnpm --filter @sessions/api build && pnpm --filter @sessions/runner build && pnpm --filter @sessions/cli build && pnpm --filter @sessions/mcp build && pnpm --filter sessions-vscode build && pnpm --filter @sessions/desktop build && pnpm --filter @sessions/web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/codevault-core packages/native-repository packages/commercial-core packages/timeline-engine packages/verification-engine --pretty false && pnpm --filter @sessions/sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter @sessions/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @sessions/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @sessions/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @sessions/mcp typecheck && pnpm --filter sessions-vscode typecheck && pnpm --filter @sessions/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @sessions/mobile typecheck && pnpm --filter @sessions/web typecheck
